summary: Rising tempo on Solar schedules only (ScheduleOptions.risingTempo, set by pacing()). Every gap, day turn and the tail gap keeps a share of itself that falls linearly by day-turn count from 1.1 on the first day to 0.5 on the last. It never goes below 300 ms or above today's caps. On a dense episode (the director pulled a lever) each day turn is the 300 ms floor (P10). The ledger keeps C2's candidates and the E1-E7 Built rows as they were measured, and adds an E8 Built row. The montage threshold is not scaled, because no such number exists.
